title: How did Euromaidan lead to Treaties on the Adoption of  the DPR, LPR, Zaporozhye State and Kherson State to Russia?
question: How did Euromaidan lead to Treaties on the Adoption of  the DPR, LPR, Zaporozhye State and Kherson State to Russia?
claim: 3 documented links lead from Euromaidan (2013) to Treaties on the Adoption of  the DPR, LPR, Zaporozhye State and Kherson State to Russia (2022): 2 of cause and effect, 1 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
